terbaru.pelajaran: We show that with a limited edge budget, this is dynamically inefficient: diffusion is dominated by the slowest-decaying modes, so enforcing a uniform guarantee spends edges on fast modes that barely affect long-term dynamics.

terbaru.judul: Flocking Time and Graph Volume in Nonlinear Cucker-Smale Models with Dynamic Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: This study proposes a Cucker-Smale model incorporating dynamic networks and the discrete $p$-Laplacian ($p \in (1,2)$) and analyzes the relationship between flocking time constraints and graph connectivity from both theoretical and experimental perspectives.

terbaru.judul: Emergence and Collapse of Leader-Follower Flocks through Phantom Targets: Surprise Nullification in Bayesian and Inverse Bayesian Inference
terbaru.pelajaran: In Bayesian and inverse Bayesian (BIB) inference, a large prediction error can trigger surprise nullification, which expands belief and likelihood variances by a common factor, leaving the updated variance ratio the same as in standard Bayesian updating.

terbaru.judul: Why do continual physical learners need sleep?
terbaru.pelajaran: To explore this question, we study a disordered spring network trained to perform a sequence of mechanical allosteric tasks through local changes in bond stiffness.

terbaru.judul: Intransigence or compromise: concatenated opinion dynamics with voting feedback
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we study opinion evolution in a sequence of Friedkin-Johnsen (FJ) models, concatenated so that the final opinions of each model serve as the initial opinions of the next.

terbaru.judul: Physics-informed neural network for model-based global computation of the asymptotic phase of limit-cycle oscillators
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we propose a physics-informed neural network to efficiently calculate the asymptotic phase of limit-cycle oscillators.

terbaru.judul: State-space symmetry in Boolean network ensembles
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we show that it is a consequence of a fundamental symmetry of Boolean network dynamics itself.

terbaru.judul: Intrinsic memory limits resonant control of complex cardiac spiral waves
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we show that intrinsic memory fundamentally alters this paradigm in complex meandering spirals typical of cardiac tissue, where phase-dependent responses to successive perturbations over the meander cycle interfere destructively to produce metastable quasi-stationarity or constructively to induce stable confinement.

terbaru.judul: Learning memory forces and bounding frequency errors in fractional Kuramoto grids
terbaru.pelajaran: Missing history creates two different demands on a forecaster for a fractional grid: predicting frequency accurately and reconstructing memory well enough to bound the prediction error.

terbaru.judul: Chimera states in a network of firefly oscillators
terbaru.pelajaran: We investigate chimera-like states in a network of identical firefly oscillators with nonlocal delayed coupling.
